says: 2026: EquipNet paid $400.00 that Tim saw arrive. Its 1099-NEC says $1,000.00, so $600.00 went to an account Tim doesn't see. 1 deposit of their own name no payer: ask who paid. 1 deposit carries a payer's name but count as the ministry's: ask. $60.00 of ministry costs they paid from their own pay come off it. Self-employment tax on $940.00 of 1099 income, net of costs, is $132.81; the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion never lowers it. The bank shows no spending abroad in 2026. If they lived abroad, ask for their travel dates: the exclusion needs 330 full days abroad in 12 months. Their filing status isn't said, so this is worked out as single: ask. Worked out on the year so far, through Oct 13: a part-year figure; the full year will differ. No federal income tax: nothing is taxable after the standard deduction. Total federal tax, all of it self-employment tax, is $132.81. With no travel dates said, it's worked out without the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion. No estimated payments are needed for 2027: under $1,000 would be owed.
